current.text: He signed with Boston on a minimum contract as veteran point guard help.
He is expected to play about 18 minutes off the bench behind Pritchard and White.
The newest preview has him as the 10th man in Boston's rotation. He could take the backup point guard role, so Boston might not need Pritchard as a bench ball handler.
Boston is very deep, with at least 12 rotation-level players. In a 10-man rotation someone misses out most nights, which puts his minutes at risk.
Experts do not expect much fantasy production from him.

durable.text: He scores very few points and gets very few rebounds, far below the top 250 pool.
He commits very few turnovers and his free throw percentage is high, but his low volume means neither moves a team's totals much.

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD and rank him around 303 to 305, far outside the 144 players drafted in our league. He should not be drafted. He shot 33.5% from the field on 18.4 minutes last season, and both sites project only about 4 to 5 points per game. Only watch him on waivers if White or Pritchard misses time and his backup point guard minutes grow clearly.
